title: Helvar's Oath
summary: Helvar couldn't speak. He left his oath written down in a barrel in the arena. Read it.

goals.name: Helvar's Oath

quest_book.title: Helvar's Oath
quest_book.author: Helvar
pages: I hold the Gate. I was set here by the one who took his head.

If I fall, the door I kept shut will open.

If you are reading this, you have killed five of us already.

Stop.

goals.say: Five of us already. What does he mean, 'us'?
